item.title: Human: Fall Flat Power Walkthrough - Level 9 Guide
item.description:
⚡ Level 9: Power

Objective: Connect colored electrical cables to circuit ports, operate heavy industrial machinery including forklifts and dump trucks, haul coal to feed furnaces, and ride high-velocity cooling fans to the exit. Level Matrix: Difficulty ⭐⭐⭐☆☆ | Est. Duration 30 Mins Mechanics: Electrical cable routing, forklift operation, heavy vehicle transport, wind draft lift, and boiler pressure systems.

📸 Grid Control: Connect batteries to power doors and drive industrial vehicles.

🗺️ Step-by-Step Level walkthrough

Stage 1: Wiring & The Short-Circuit

  • Walkthrough: Walk up to the starting wall panel. Grab the red cable plug and connect it to the red socket; grab the blue cable plug and connect it to the blue socket. This powers the door. If you want the “Electricity 101” achievement, swap the plug connections to link a single wire directly into both positive and negative terminals (connecting blue to red socket) to trigger an explosive short-circuit.

Stage 2: Forklift Controls & The Statue Battery

  • Walkthrough:
    1. Enter the next yard to find a yellow forklift. Stand on the seat, grab the steering wheel to drive it, and slide the metal forks under the heavy metal roller gate.
    2. Operate the lever to lift the forks, opening the gate.
    3. In the courtyard, locate the giant stone statue holding a glowing battery in its hand.
    4. Climb up the statue’s pedestal, scale its arms, and knock the battery out of its grip to claim it.

Stage 3: Coal Hauling & Boiler Feed ⭐ Key Puzzle

  • Standard Walkthrough:
    1. Locate the dump truck. Drive it back to the dark coal quarry/cave.
    2. Use your hands to pick up pieces of coal and toss at least 10 pieces into the bed of the truck.
    3. Drive the truck back to the generator building. Dump the coal near the furnaces.
    4. Feed the coal into the open furnace chambers to generate steam pressure.

Stage 4: Floating on Aerodynamic Fans

  • Walkthrough:
    1. Connect three batteries (including the one stolen from the statue) to the main power terminal to power the giant ceiling fan.
    2. Stand directly under the fan. As it starts rotating, the upward wind draft will lift Bob into the air.
    3. Float across the deep void, using your movement keys to steer Bob toward the exit hatch on the far platform.

💡 Pro Tips & Glitch Hacks

【Forklift Gate Climbing & Fan Blade Launch】
You do not need to operate the forklift. By parking it against the gate and climbing onto its roll cage, you can reach the top of the wall and jump over, skipping the lever puzzles. Additionally, in the fan room, you can perform a wobbly wall-run along the pipes on the side wall to jump directly to the exit platform, skipping the battery connection.

🏆 Hidden Achievements & Easter Eggs

  1. ⚡ The End?: Unlocked automatically by completing the “Power” level.
  2. 💥 Electricity 101: Short-circuit the starting panel by connecting a single cable between the positive and negative terminals.
  3. 🗿 Thief: Steal the battery held by the giant stone statue in the courtyard.
  4. 🔋 Will It Fry: Feed a single appliance (such as the main generator door) with power from 3 batteries simultaneously.
  5. 🏎️ Petrolhead: Cumulative distance achievement. Drive the forklift or the dump truck for a total distance of 1 kilometer around the map.
  6. 🚚 Delivery Boy: Load 10 pieces of coal into the dump truck and successfully deliver them to the main island boiler room.

📊 Level Telemetry

Est. Duration 25 - 35 Mins Connect cables firmly into sockets to avoid sparking
Speedrun Record 1 Min 05 Sec Climb the forklift roof to bypass the locked roller gates

item.title: Human: Fall Flat Dark Walkthrough - Level 11 Guide
item.description:
🌃 Level 11: Dark

Objective: Navigate the spooky nighttime estate, restore power to the security gates using wire circuits, climb the rotating clock tower gears, and fire up the steam generator to ride the pulley zipline to the exit. Level Matrix: Difficulty ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ | Est. Duration 30 Mins Mechanics: Wiring circuits, heavy axe swinging, gear platforming, coal shoveling, and high-tension wire sliding.

📸 Spooky Estate: Welcome to the night. Watch your step around the cliffs and industrial generator yards.

🗺️ Step-by-Step Level Walkthrough

Stage 1: The Haunted Starting Ledge

  • Goal: Reach the main castle courtyard.
  • Walkthrough:
    1. You wake up on a dark cliff terrace. Pick up the wooden plank lying nearby and drag it across the gap to create a bridge.
    2. Walk across carefully. Look up and grab the lanterns if you fall, or swing across using the iron ring on the wall.
    3. Use the hand lever next to the metal gate to lift it, sliding underneath to enter the estate grounds.

Stage 2: The Double Battery Gate

  • Goal: Find two electrical batteries to power the liftgate.
  • Walkthrough:
    1. Locate the circuit board next to the locked gate. It requires two batteries (one blue, one red).
    2. Battery 1 (Red): Climb the stone steps on the left. You will see the red battery on a high stone pillar. Grab a nearby bench or box, stand on it, and pull the battery down.
    3. Battery 2 (Blue): Head to the shed on the right. The window is boarded up. Grab the heavy iron axe from the wall and swing it to break the wooden planks blocking the window. Climb in, grab the blue battery, and throw it out the window.
    4. Drag both batteries to the circuit slots next to the gate. Plug them in, pull the lever, and proceed to the courtyard.

Stage 3: The Tree Bridge & Axe Chopping

  • Walkthrough:
    1. You will face a deep trench with a tall pine tree on the opposite side.
    2. Grab the axe and hit the base of the tree (or pull the wooden wedges supporting the tree trunk).
    3. The tree will fall over the gap, creating a narrow log bridge. Walk across it (using Shift to lower your center of gravity for balance).

Stage 4: The Clock Tower Gears ⭐ Key Puzzle

This platforming section requires timing and coordination.

📸 Clock Gears: Climb the rotating wooden cogs to reach the face of the clock.
  • Standard Walkthrough:
    1. Enter the tower base. Climb the stone steps to reach the first rotating gear.
    2. Jump onto the flat side of the wooden cogs. Let the gear rotate you to the other side, then leap to the next counter-rotating cog.
    3. Grab the heavy iron key hanging on the wall and use it to unlock the metal padlock on the clock mechanism.
    4. Move the massive clock hands outside by grabbing and pushing them from the window ledge. Align the hands to 12:00 to trigger the drawbridge to lower.

Stage 5: The Boiler and Zipline Escape

The final puzzle requires you to power up a steam-powered elevator and ride a cable.

  • Standard Walkthrough:
    1. Enter the generator room. Shovel pieces of coal from the pile into the furnace.
    2. Close the furnace door and pull the lever to start the steam turbine. The pressure gauge will rise.
    3. Ride the rising steam elevator platform to the highest balcony.
    4. Grab the copper wiring harness from the floor and connect it to the electrical transformer box to power the cable pulley.
    5. Grab the handle of the pulley, jump off the edge, and zipline across the sky to the final exit portal.

💡 Pro Tips & Glitch Hacks

【Zipline Speedrun Skip】
You do not need to wire the final transformer box to use the zipline. Instead, grab the backup generator plug (the heavy yellow cord), drag it to the balcony ledge, jump off while holding the plug, and snag the pulley wire on your way down. The physics engine will sling you straight to the portal!

🏆 Hidden Easter Eggs

  1. 🔔 Bells of Doom: In the clock tower room, there are three bells. Grab a stick or use your hands to strike all three bells in sequence (Small, Medium, Large) to hear a secret chord and unlock a hidden achievement.
  2. 🕯️ Torch Lighter: Find the secret torch in the cave passage. Use the embers in the furnace to light the torch and carry it to the cave altar to illuminate a hidden drawing of Bob.

📊 Level Telemetry

Speedrun Record 1 Min 12 Sec Use wall climbs to skip the entire battery room
